value.title: Pingu & The Egg
value.synopsis: When Pingu is asked to watch over some eggs, the eggs end up going all over the city.

value.title: Pingu Makes a Movie!
value.synopsis: Pingu attempts to make a movie, but finds it harder than he imagined.

value.title: Pingu is a Rock Star!
value.synopsis: Pingu and his friends form a band for a talent show.

value.title: Household Helping Hands
value.synopsis: Pingu and Pinga look after the house when their mum and dad are ill.

value.title: Pingu The Wig Maker!
value.synopsis: The Inventor creates a wig machine, and Pingu starts his own salon with it.

value.title: Pingu On Patrol!
value.synopsis: Pingu is appointed to a junior police officer after he catches a penguin littering, but he takes it too far in patrolling the city.

value.title: Pingu's Frozen Discovery
value.synopsis: Pingu and the Inventor find a fossil inside some ice.

value.title: Pingu's Treasure Hunt
value.synopsis: Pingu's dad sets up a treasure hunt for Pingu and Pinga to solve.

value.title: Voyage to the Moon
value.synopsis: Pingu and Robby make a spaceship in the back garden and let their imagination take over.

value.title: Pingu's Traffic Dance
value.synopsis: Pingu helps out the police by directing traffic after an accident causes a traffic jam.

value.title: I want to be on TV!
value.synopsis: Pingu decides to do anything it takes to get himself on the small screen.

value.title: Flea Market
value.synopsis: Pingu's family struggle to sell their junk at the flea market.

value.title: Pingu the Living Statue
value.synopsis: Pingu accidentally breaks a new statue and comes up with an innovative replacement.

value.title: Pingu's Snack Attack
value.synopsis: Pingu sets a trap for a pesky seagull who has been stealing his treats.

value.title: Pingu the Conductor
value.synopsis: A concert performance inspires Pingu to put on his own musical show.
